name: Armada
description: Armada is privately held and has no ticker. Review its funding rounds and valuations, the investors and SPVs that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Armada is a privately held edge computing company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the valuations at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $230 million Series B round announced on May 19, 2026, valued the company at $2 billion before the new investment.

Founded in 2022 and based in San Francisco, Armada builds modular data centers, together with the software and connectivity that run them, for industrial, energy and government customers operating in remote locations. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions, frequently through special purpose vehicles, and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
figs: Special purpose vehicles with SEC filings naming Armada
table_note: The Series B valuation is post-money; the company announced a valuation of $2 billion before the new investment. The December 2023 amount is the combined total of two rounds that Armada raised before it emerged from stealth, as reported at the time.
round_notes: Armada said on May 19, 2026 that the Series B brought its total funding to nearly $500 million. The company did not disclose a valuation for its July 2025 strategic round.

A round valuation reflects the terms of the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Overmatch, BlackRock and 8090 Industries co-led the Series B, in which Johnson Controls, NightDragon, Mitsui and Singtel Innov8 also invested. Pinegrove, Veriten and Glade Brook joined the July 2025 strategic round, and 8090 Industries, Founders Fund, Lux Capital and Shield Capital led the funding that Armada raised before December 2023. Other investors include Felicis, Marlinspike, Silent Ventures, Microsoft's venture fund M12 and Valor Equity Partners.
spv_sentence: Since 2024, seven special purpose vehicles formed to invest in Armada have filed with the SEC, three of them in 2026.
sources: Sources: Armada's announcements of its Series B (May 19, 2026) and strategic funding round (July 24, 2025); reports by SiliconANGLE (July 2025), Via Satellite (December 2023) and Payload (December 2023); and SEC Form D filings.
